explore.legend.title: Data legend
explore.legend.hic.axis: Genomic position (bp) along the chromosome; values log-scaled.
explore.legend.hic.colorScale: Contact frequency — log₁₀ of observed reads per bin pair.
explore.legend.hic.diagonal: Self-ligation signal; rises sharply with Hi-C library quality.
explore.legend.hic.offDiagonal: Long-range contacts — distance-dependent decay indicates 3D proximity.
explore.legend.tracks.bigwig: Continuous signal (RNA-seq, H3K4me3, H3K27ac) over the region.
explore.legend.tracks.bedgraph: Discrete scores (AB index, insulation) — TAD boundaries are visible as drops.
explore.legend.tracks.tad: TAD rectangle — topologically associating domain, ~0.2–2 Mb.
explore.legend.tracks.gene: Gene model — exons (thick) and introns (thin line with arrows).
explore.legend.threeD.tube: Chromatin fiber skeleton — the 3D fold derived from Hi-C contact data (Catmull-Rom smoothed), rainbow-graded along the path (blue → red).
explore.legend.threeD.sphere: Beads on the fiber — one bead per genomic bin, colored along the path to show order.
explore.legend.threeD.arc: PEI interaction arc — the green sphere marks an enhancer; the arc links its promoter to the enhancer.
explore.legend.ctcf.logo: Sequence logo — letter height = information content at each position.
explore.legend.ctcf.pie: Population allele frequency (ref / het / alt) at the anchor.
explore.legend.ctcf.anchor: Anchor position — vertical line projected onto the motif logo.

about.title: About Animal Allele-Resolved Multi-omics
about.subtitle: Multi-omics 3D genome browser for pigs and chickens
about.overview.title: What is Animal Allele-Resolved Multi-omics?
about.overview.body: Animal Allele-Resolved Multi-omics is an interactive platform dedicated to functional genomic studies in pigs (Sus scrofa 11.1) and chickens (Gallus gallus). It integrates gene expression, epigenetic modifications, and chromatin conformation data, providing a user-friendly interface to search and explore the biological functions and regulatory mechanisms of annotated genes.
about.overview.body2: In diploid mammals, allele-specific three-dimensional (3D) genome architecture may lead to imbalanced gene expression. Through ultra-deep in situ Hi-C sequencing of representative somatic tissues (skeletal muscle, liver, and brain) from hybrid pigs and hybrid chickens generated by reciprocal crosses of phenotypically and physiologically divergent breeds, the platform uncovers extensive chromatin reorganization between homologous chromosomes across multiple scales.
about.data.title: Data scope
about.data.tissues: Somatic tissues: skeletal muscle, liver, brain
about.data.omics: Omics layers: Hi-C, RNA-seq, histone ChIP-seq / CUT&Tag, CTCF, structural variation
about.data.derived: Derived tracks: A/B compartments, TAD boundaries, insulation, PEI anchors, CTCF loops
about.features.title: What you can do
about.features.viz: Interactive visualization — Hi-C contact maps, multi-omics tracks, 3D chromatin, CTCF motif & genotype
about.features.compare: Comparison — open any two samples side-by-side and diff every view, or browse curated cases
about.features.download: Bulk download — fetch per-sample Hi-C, bigWig and VCF files with resume support
about.tech.title: Technology
about.tech.body: FastAPI backend with deterministic mock fallback; React 18 + TypeScript frontend rendering via WebGL2, Three.js, Plotly and SVG.
